headline: Executive order signed April 23, 2025, directs changes to federal policy on discipline in schools.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with how federal policy treats student discipline in schools. Its title suggests it brings back an earlier federal approach to school discipline, likely replacing more recent guidance. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies involved, and requirements are not clear from the source material.

who_it_affects.group: K-12 public schools and school districts
who_it_affects.how: Federal guidance on how they set and enforce student discipline rules may change.
School discipline practices that affect students could change depending on how schools respond to new federal guidance.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 23, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the material provided.
